description: Two independent cloners, each copying one monophonic input across up to 16 identical polyphonic channels

params.text: Sets how many copies of that half's input go to its output, 1 to 16; it comes up at 16

inputs.text: The signal that half copies; only the first channel of a cable here is read
Sets the number of copies for that half: 0V gives one channel and 10V gives 16, and while a cable is here the clone count knob is ignored

outputs.text: Carries that half's input repeated across as many channels as the clone count sets

notes: The two halves are independent: the lower one is a second cloner, not a second stage.

inputs.2:
0 to 10V · stepped · one channel only

a negative voltage does nothing here.
inputs.3:
0 to 10V · stepped · one channel only

a negative voltage does nothing here.
